prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions were generally overly optimistic, though certain new flows and compact layouts outperformed expectations.
Reordering sign-in (sign_in, reorder) was helpful in 3 winning tests, though specific placements hurt or showed no clear effect.
Sign-in copy tweaks (sign_in, copy), finish hints (finish, hint), and home hints (home, hint) showed no clear effect across multiple tests.
Adding a new finish screen (finish, new_screen) hurt performance or showed no clear effect.
Home wait info changes (home, wait_info) were helpful in 1 winning test, while 3 tests showed no clear effect.
Evidence remains thin for any change kind tested only once, requiring at least 2 tests to state a rule.

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Adoption Certificate Two-Column Layout Redesign: Redesign the adoption certificate screen into a two-column layout displaying the pet preview on one side and official details on the other. (why: Adoption drop-off is high (69.6% conversion, median 89s), indicating users spend significant time and drop out before finalizing their pet adoption.)
1: [adoption, new_flow] Pick Friend Video Preview Audio Flow: Introduce a video and sound preview component flow on the pick friend screen to let users hear and see animated pet behaviors before adopting. (why: Adoption step drops conversion down to 69.6% and support received reports of users confused about pet behaviors after onboarding.)
2: [home, new_flow] Waiting Screen Mascot Sound Progress Flow: Add a mascot component accompanied by audio feedback sound when background rendering completes on the waiting screen. (why: The home step (waiting screen) has a median time of 201s and mean of 2336s, causing drop-offs while waiting for background generation.)
3: [sign_in, notification] Sign In Desktop Access Progress Notification: Add step progress and notification indicator on the sign-in screen to clarify account authentication progress. (why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or reset after signing in again, and 2 emails noted sign-in screen stalling.)
4: [finish, incentive] Home Intro Companion Audio Greeting Incentive: Add a welcome mascot and interactive audio greeting badge on the home intro screen to celebrate setup completion. (why: Finish step drops conversion to 71.4% with median 395s / mean 5815s duration, showing users need positive reinforcement before entering the desktop pet view.)
5: [choose_path, hint] Story Screen Step Counter Progress Display: Display step counter and remaining time estimate on the story screen to orient new users. (why: Choose path funnel shows a mean duration of 514s; setting clear expectations early helps reduce early drop-off.)
6: [adoption, hint] Upload Photos Mascot Visual Helper: Add a visual mascot helper with hint text on the photo upload screen to guide custom pet creation. (why: Support received 3 emails about custom pet generation failing or looking wrong, and adoption conversion is lowest at 69.6%.)
7: [home, layout] Waiting Screen Progress Checklist Layout: Update the waiting screen layout to checklist format displaying background generation status items. (why: Home step waiting screen takes median 201s / mean 2336s, causing user drop-off due to lack of feedback during pet generation.)
8: [sign_in, layout] Sign In Checklist Layout Redesign: Update the sign-in screen layout to checklist format showing account backup benefits. (why: 8 support emails cited pets missing or reset after re-login, so presenting account benefits clearly reduces confusion.)
